notes: With Arcanas enabled a run can have up to 3 (more only via special means: Queen Sigma, Inverse-mode Merchant for 20,000 gold, Moonlight Bolero bosses' chests). At the start of a run the player picks one unlocked Arcana (or a random one). At 11:00 and 21:00 in 30-minute stages a special glowing-bat boss spawns and drops an Arcana Chest offering 4 random uncollected Arcanas (6 and one free reroll if the player has unlocked 23+ Arcanas/Darkanas). In Boss Rash, Bat Country and Tiny Bridge the bosses spawn at 5:00 and 10:00; other non-30:00 stages may differ. Once the player holds 3 Arcanas the bosses drop regular chests; with Arcanas disabled the bosses do not appear. Rerolls can be spent on Arcana choices (since patch 0.6.1); previously shown options are not offered again until all have been shown. Arcana drafts can also be skipped. The first Arcana (Sarabande of Healing) unlocks by finding the Randomazzo in Gallo Tower; others by reaching level 50 with a character or minute 31 in a stage.

arcanas.name: Gemini
arcanas.description: Listed weapons come with a counterpart.
arcanas.effect_summary: Certain weapons are accompanied by a functionally identical counterpart weapon that levels up at the same time. Examples: Peachone/Ebony Wings get Cygnus/Zhar Ptytsia (attack slightly further outward); Phiera Der Tuphello/Eight The Sparrow get Red Muscle/Twice Upon a Time (slightly different angle); Gatti Amari gets Flock Destroyer (3 cat variants); Ammo Appalate gets Horse Cartridge (fires behind the character); Santa Javelin gets Levelin'Eh; Prism Lass gets Prism Damsel; Raging Fire, Ice Fang, Rock Riot, Gale Force, Fulgur, Keremet Bubbles, Refectio, Hex, Globus, Anura get 'Speculo' versions.

arcanas.name: Twilight Requiem
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles generate explosions when they expire. Explosions damage is affected by Curse.
arcanas.effect_summary: When projectiles of listed weapons expire they create a horizontal explosion. Damage is about 10 at +0% Curse plus ~13.5 per +100% Curse (e.g. +200% Curse = 40, +900% = 140, +9900% = 1340). Affects King Bible line, Lightning Ring line, Peachone/Ebony Wings, Runetracer, Shadow Pinion, Bone line, Celestial Dusting line, Bracelet line, Santa Javelin line, Silver Wind line, Scarlet Needle line, Prismatic Missile/Luminaire, C-U-Laser line, Vampire Killer, Jet Black Whip line, Refectio/Hex lines, Spirit Rings, Sanguine Star line, Glaive line.

arcanas.name: Tragic Princess
arcanas.description: The cooldown of the listed weapons reduces when moving.
arcanas.effect_summary: Listed weapons gain reduced Cooldown while the player is moving; faster movement gives greater reduction. Acts independently of the Cooldown stat (works even beyond -90%). The wiki gives no exact percentage.

arcanas.name: Awake
arcanas.description: Gives +3 Revivals. Consuming a Revival gives +10% Max Health, +1 Armor, and +5% Might, Area, Duration, and Speed.
arcanas.effect_summary: Grants 3 Revivals immediately. Each Revival consumed (from any source: this arcana, the Revival power-up, character passives) permanently gives x1.1 Max Health, +1 Armor, and +5% Might, Area, Duration and Speed.

arcanas.name: Chaos in the Dark Night
arcanas.description: Overall projectile Speed continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% projectile Speed every level.
arcanas.effect_summary: Overall projectile Speed is multiplied by an oscillating factor from 0.5 to 1.5 over 10 second cycles (net neutral on average). Also +1% Speed per level up gained after the arcana is taken (not retroactive).

stat_effects.speed: +1% per level up (after pickup), plus oscillating x0.5..x1.5 over 10s

arcanas.name: Sarabande of Healing
arcanas.description: Healing is doubled. Recovering HP damages nearby enemies for the same amount.
arcanas.effect_summary: All healing is doubled. Every heal triggers an area-of-effect pulse at a fixed range (affected by Area; base area 4, 0.3s duration) dealing damage equal to the amount healed. Pulse ignores Might and does not require missing HP. Revival counts as a heal (to half, doubled to full).

arcanas.name: Iron Blue Will
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces and might pass through enemies and walls.
arcanas.effect_summary: Listed projectiles gain up to 3 bounces (triggered mostly on hitting an enemy) and can pass through enemies and ignore walls. Death Spiral bounces off screen edge once; Flash Arrow/Millionaire and Carrello get +3 screen bounces; Prototype A/B/C drone projectiles get +1 bounce.

arcanas.name: Mad Groove
arcanas.description: Every 2 minutes attracts all standard stage items, pickups, and light sources towards the character.
arcanas.effect_summary: On pickup and at every even minute on the in-game timer, all stage items, treasure chests, pickups (incl. XP gems) and a maximum count of light sources are moved into a circle around the player. Does not attract relics.

arcanas.name: Divine Bloodline
arcanas.description: Armor also affects listed weapons' damage and reflects enemy damage. Character gains bonus damage depending on missing Health. Defeating enemies with retaliatory damage gives +0.5 Max Health.
arcanas.effect_summary: Listed weapons deal +5 flat damage per Armor (cap +250). All weapons gain +0.1 flat damage per missing HP below Max Health (uncapped). Enemies touching the character take 10 flat damage per Armor (via a 0.3s AoE pulse). Killing an enemy with retaliatory damage gives +0.5 Max Health.

stat_effects.armor: +5 flat dmg per Armor (cap 250) on listed weapons

arcanas.name: Beginning
arcanas.description: Listed weapons get +1 Amount. The character's main weapon and its evolution gain +3 Amount instead.
arcanas.effect_summary: The character's starting weapon (and its evolution) gains +3 Amount. Bone, Carrello, Celestial Dusting, Cherry Bomb and La Robba (if not the starting weapon) gain +1 Amount.

arcanas.name: Waltz of Pearls
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces.
arcanas.effect_summary: Listed projectiles gain up to 3 bounces (Magic Wand line, Fire Wand line and Sonic Bloom can hit 3 more targets per shot). Hellfire and Wave Beam bounce off screen edge once, Cross and Heaven Sword twice, Carrello three more times.

arcanas.name: Out of Bounds
arcanas.description: Freezing enemies generates explosions. Orologions are easier to find. Sorbettos could also be found.
arcanas.effect_summary: Freezing an enemy summons an explosion (base damage 10 + SecondsSurvived/30, i.e. about +2 per minute; 0.3s AoE). Orologion spawn weight doubled (to 4); Sorbetto weight x4 and it can appear in light sources. Applies to freezing weapons such as Clock Lancet, Celestial Voulge (5% crit+freeze), Prism Lass line, Fleuret line, Mirage Robe.

arcanas.name: Wicked Season
arcanas.description: Overall Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse are doubled at fixed intervals. The character starts gaining +1% Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse every 2 levels.
arcanas.effect_summary: Every 10 seconds the doubled stat rotates in order Growth, Luck, Greed, Curse (the current one is temporarily doubled; base 100% is doubled too). Each level up gives +0.5% to all four stats (not retroactive).

stat_effects.growth: +0.5% per level up, doubled in rotation
stat_effects.luck: +0.5% per level up, doubled in rotation
stat_effects.greed: +0.5% per level up, doubled in rotation
stat_effects.curse: +0.5% per level up, doubled in rotation

arcanas.name: Jail of Crystal
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles have a chance to freeze enemies.
arcanas.effect_summary: Listed weapon projectiles have a 25% chance (multiplied by Luck) to freeze enemies; freeze duration based on the weapon's Duration. Prism Lass/Damsel chance raised from 5% to 25%; Icebrand and Ninth Circle from 5% to 35%; Dragon Water Whip/Hydrostormer Tip 10%.

arcanas.name: Disco of Gold
arcanas.description: Picking up coin bags from the floor triggers Gold Fever. Obtaining gold restores as many HP.
arcanas.effect_summary: Collecting any gold (coins, coin bags, treasure chests, big coin bags, Vicious Hunger gold) heals the player by the same amount, scaled by Greed (Recovery does not multiply it). Picking up Coin Bag / Rich Coin Bag triggers Gold Fever (as Gilded Clover).

arcanas.name: Slash
arcanas.description: Enables critical hits for listed weapons. Doubles overall critical damage.
arcanas.effect_summary: Certain listed weapons gain the ability to critically hit (Whip, Knife, Axe, Ammo Appalate, Victory Sword, Eskizzibur lines, whip evolutions etc.), and critical hits from all sources deal double damage. Exact crit chance per weapon not recorded here.

arcanas.name: Lost & Found Painting
arcanas.description: Overall Duration continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Duration every level.
arcanas.effect_summary: Overall Duration is multiplied by an oscillating factor from 0.5 to 1.5 over 10 second cycles (net neutral on average). Also +1% Duration per level up after pickup (not retroactive).

stat_effects.duration: +1% per level up, oscillating x0.5..x1.5 over 10s

arcanas.name: Boogaloo of Illusions
arcanas.description: Overall Area continuously changes between -25% and +25% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Area every level.
arcanas.effect_summary: Overall Area is multiplied by an oscillating factor from 0.75 to 1.25 over 10 second cycles (net neutral on average). Also +1% Area per level up after pickup (not retroactive).

stat_effects.area: +1% per level up, oscillating x0.75..x1.25 over 10s

arcanas.name: Heart of Fire
arcanas.description: Listed weapon projectiles explode on impact. Light sources explode. Character explodes when damaged.
arcanas.effect_summary: Listed weapon projectiles create an explosion on impact dealing 50% of base damage (weapons already explosive gain +50% explosive damage). Light sources explode. The character emits a base-damage-10 explosion (0.3s AoE) when damaged. Explosion damage counts as retaliation.

arcanas.name: Silent Old Sanctuary
arcanas.description: Gives +3 Reroll, Skip, and Banish. Gives +20% Might and -8% Cooldown for each active weapon slot left empty.
arcanas.effect_summary: Grants +3 Reroll, +3 Skip, +3 Banish. For every empty active weapon slot: +20% Might and -8% Cooldown (max +100% Might, -40% Cooldown).

arcanas.name: Blood Astronomia
arcanas.description: Listed weapons also emit special damaging zones affected by Amount and Magnet. Enemies within Magnet range take damage based on Amount.
arcanas.effect_summary: Listed weapons additionally place damaging zones based on their own stats (Garlic/Soul Eater: ground zones sized by max(Magnet radius/32, weapon Area), count = Amount, lasting Duration; Pentagram, Song of Mana, Clock Lancet, Laurel, Sonic Dash have their own variants). The player's Magnet area becomes a damage zone: base damage 5 x Amount, 2s cooldown, no knockback, ignores Area/Duration/Speed.

stat_effects.magnet: Magnet radius becomes a damage zone

arcanas.name: Game Killer
arcanas.description: Halts XP gain. Experience Gems turn into exploding projectiles. All Treasure Chests contain at least 3 items.
arcanas.effect_summary: No experience is gained from gems; instead collected gems hurl themselves at the nearest enemy as exploding projectiles (damage multiplied by Growth, Stained Glass explosion, base damage 10). All Treasure Chests contain at least three weapons or passive items.
arcanas.unlock: Defeat The Ender in Cappella Magna.
